itinerary.title: Day 1: 7 Lakes Tour (14 Hours Between Tour and Travel) - in a group
itinerary.body: Pickup is around 4:00 am at your hotel. Please make sure to be ready on time. Don’t forget to bring warm clothing for this adventure. We will head south of Cusco and arrive at the village of Pacchanta , which will take around 3 and a half hours. Along the way, you’ll have the opportunity to see the sunrise and enjoy the beautiful scenery along the route, and we’ll make a stop for breakfast. Around 8:30 am, we’ll begin our 3 and a half hour hike to visit the 7 lakes. You’ll have the chance to see these magical lakes and the mystique that surrounds them. After visiting the 7 lakes, we’ll return to the small village of Pacchanta for a well-deserved rest and lunch. If you’d like, you can take an optional soak in the thermal waters of Pacchanta (optional), keeping in mind that this is an optional activity and if you don’t want to participate, you’ll have free time to explore the surroundings of this magical village. Then we’ll return to the Imperial City of the Incas. We’ll arrive in Cusco around 6:30 pm.
